🔥 Quiz 1 必考真題

24 條真題＋完整解析：題目、答案、點解係咁、老師口講重點。老師提示：大多數考試題目都喺入面！

題目同答案按課堂文件《Answer to Quiz 1 Introduction to HK Law》逐字記錄；「老師口講重點」為機器轉錄，僅供參考；有缺口嘅地方已標明，唔會估。

1a · 基本法第 8 條 — 舊有法律

題目：
According to Article 8 of the Basic Law of HKSAR, the laws previously in force in Hong Kong, shall be maintained, except for any that contravene the Basic Law, and subject to any amendment by the legislature of the HKSAR. Q: What are the laws previously in force in Hong Kong?

答案：
1. the common law
2. rules of equity
3. ordinances
4. subordinate legislation
5. customary law

點解係咁 (English)：
Article 8 preserves the pre-1997 legal system so that Hong Kong's law continues after the handover: only laws that contravene the Basic Law fall away, and the legislature may amend the rest. The five items are the components of that system — judge-made common law and equity, legislation (ordinances and subordinate legislation), and Chinese customary law, which survives mainly in New Territories land rights and the legitimacy of children.

點解係咁（中文）：
基本法第 8 條的作用係保持法律連續性：回歸之前行緊的法律繼續有效，除非抵觸基本法，立法會亦可以修訂。五項內容就係舊有法律制度的組成部分——法官造法的普通法同衡平法、立法機關制定的條例同附屬法例，以及中國習慣法（主要保留喺新界土地權益同子女婚生地位方面）。

🎤 老師口講重點（機器轉錄，僅供參考）：

  • 老師重複話呢題問的是香港現有／回歸之前的法律。IMG_5246.MOV [2.03–8.47]：「香港現有的法律 或者回歸之前的法律」。 ---
1b · 基本法第 18 條 — 現行法律

題目：
Q: What are the laws in force in the HKSAR in accordance with Article 18 of the Basic Law of HKSAR?

答案：
Article 18 of Basic Law:
1. Basic Law of HKSAR
2. the laws previously in force in Hong Kong including (the common law / rules of equity / ordinances / subordinate legislation / customary law)
3. the laws enacted by the legislature of HKSAR
4. the National Law promulgated by the NPCSC through Annex III of Basic Law, e.g., the National Security Law of HK

點解係咁 (English)：
Article 18 defines the complete body of law in force in the HKSAR, in four layers: the Basic Law itself, the preserved pre-1997 laws (the five items from Q1a), laws enacted by the HKSAR legislature, and national laws listed in Annex III and applied by promulgation or legislation, such as the National Security Law. Together these four layers are the whole of Hong Kong law after 1997.

點解係咁（中文）：
基本法第 18 條列出特區現行法律的四個層次：基本法本身、保留的回歸前法律（即第 1a 題的五項）、立法會制定的法律，以及列入附件三、全國人大常委會公布實施的全國性法律（例如國安法）。四層加埋就係 1997 年之後香港法律的全部。

🎤 老師口講重點（機器轉錄，僅供參考）：

  • 口講與第 1 題連續（同一段講解，無分段界線），見第 1 題 IMG_5246.MOV [2.03–10.09]。 ---
1c · 國安法第 2 條／基本法第 1、12 條

題目：
Article 2 of The Law of the PRC on Safeguarding National Security in the HKSAR provides that "The provisions in Articles 1 and 12 of the Basic Law of the HKSAR on the legal status of the HKSAR are the fundamental provisions in the Basic Law. No institution, organization or individual in the Region shall contravene these provisions in exercising their rights and freedoms." Q: What are the contents of the said Articles 1 and 12 of the Basic Law?

答案：
Article 1 of Basic Law: The Hong Kong Special Administrative Region is an inalienable part of the People's Republic of China. Article 12 of Basic Law: The Hong Kong Special Administrative Region shall be a local administrative region of the People's Republic of China, which shall enjoy a high degree of autonomy and come directly under the Central People's Government.

點解係咁 (English)：
Article 2 of the National Security Law calls Articles 1 and 12 the "fundamental provisions" because they state the HKSAR's constitutional status. Article 1 is the "one country" side: the HKSAR is an inalienable part of the PRC, so sovereignty is not negotiable. Article 12 is the "two systems" side: the HKSAR is a local administrative region that enjoys a high degree of autonomy and comes directly under the Central People's Government. No institution, organisation or individual may act against these provisions when exercising rights and freedoms.

點解係咁（中文）：
國安法第 2 條稱第 1、12 條為「根本性條款」，因為佢哋講的是特區的憲制地位。第 1 條係「一國」嗰邊：香港特別行政區係中華人民共和國不可分離的部分，主權無得傾。第 12 條係「兩制」嗰邊：特區係享有高度自治權的地方行政區域，直轄於中央人民政府。任何機構、組織同個人行使權利自由時都唔可以違反呢兩條。

🎤 老師口講重點（機器轉錄，僅供參考）：

  • 老師話第 12 條講高度自治，寫到「高度自治」已經係核心；到時會寬鬆畀分。IMG_5249.MOV [12.34–16.86]：「我到時要寬鬆處理」；IMG_5249.MOV [32.56–54.20]：「第12條香港特區是一個高度自治這裡有高度自治如果你寫到高度自治其實已經是強克的核心」（「強克」為誤聽）。 ---
1d · 國安法第 1 條 — 立法目的

題目：
Article 23 of the Basic Law provides that "The HKSAR shall enact laws on its own to prohibit any act of treason, secession, sedition, subversion against the Central People's Government, or theft of state secrets, to prohibit foreign political organizations or bodies from conducting political activities in the Region, and to prohibit political organizations or bodies of the Region from establishing ties with foreign political organizations or bodies." Q: What is the purpose of the enactment of The Law of the PRC on Safeguarding National Security in the HKSAR as mentioned in Article 1 of the said Law?

答案：
Article 1 of the Law of the PRC on Safeguarding National Security in the HKSAR provides as follows: This Law is enacted, in accordance with (a) the Constitution of the PRC, (b) the Basic Law of HKSAR, and (c) the Decision of the NPC on Establishing and Improving the Legal System and Enforcement Mechanisms for Safeguarding National Security in HKSAR, for the purpose of:
1. ensuring the resolute, full and faithful implementation of the policy of One Country, Two Systems under which the people of Hong Kong administer Hong Kong with a high degree of autonomy;
2. safeguarding national security;
3. preventing, suppressing and imposing punishment for the offences of secession, subversion, organization and perpetration of terrorist activities, and collusion with a foreign country or with external elements to endanger national security in relation to HKSAR;
4. maintaining prosperity and stability of the HKSAR;
5. protecting the lawful rights and interests of the residents of HKSAR.

點解係咁 (English)：
Article 1 of the National Security Law states its own purpose, and the five purposes share one thread: the law is a safeguarding measure. It was enacted under the PRC Constitution, the Basic Law and the NPC Decision to implement "One Country, Two Systems" faithfully, to safeguard national security by preventing and punishing the four offences in Q1e, to keep Hong Kong prosperous and stable, and to protect residents' lawful rights and interests. Note that the Basic Law Article 23 duty quoted in the question — for Hong Kong to enact its own laws on treason, secession, sedition, subversion and related acts — is the background to the 2020 law, not the law itself.

點解係咁（中文）：
國安法第 1 條講明自己立法的目的，五個目的有一條主線：呢條法係保障措施。佢根據《中華人民共和國憲法》、基本法同人大決定而制定，目的係堅決、全面、準確落實「一國兩制」（港人治港、高度自治）、保障國家安全（防範、制止同懲治第 1e 題的四罪）、維護香港繁榮穩定，以及保障居民合法權益。留意返，題目引述的基本法第 23 條（特區自行立法禁止叛國、分裂、煽動、顛覆等行為）係 2020 年立法的背景，唔係呢條法本身。

1e · 國安法四罪

題目：
What are the four criminal offences prohibited by The Law of the PRC on Safeguarding National Security in the HKSAR?

答案：
1. Secession
2. Subversion
3. terrorist activities
4. collusion with a foreign country or external elements to endanger national security

點解係咁 (English)：
The four offences are defined in the National Security Law itself: secession (Article 20, splitting the country), subversion (Article 22, overthrowing state power), terrorist activities (Article 24, causing grave harm to society), and collusion with a foreign country or external elements (Article 29). They are the four acts the law was made to prevent and punish, and each one is marked separately in the exam, so all four must be listed.

點解係咁（中文）：
四罪由國安法本身界定：分裂國家（第 20 條）、顛覆國家政權（第 22 條）、恐怖活動（第 24 條，對社會造成嚴重危害）、勾結外國或者境外勢力危害國家安全（第 29 條）。佢哋就係呢條法要防範同懲治的四種行為，考試逐項計分，四項都要寫齊。

🎤 老師口講重點（機器轉錄，僅供參考）：

  • 老師用 SSTC（四罪首字母）做記憶法，又話四罪逐項計分，連攞 49 分的同學都差啲寫唔齊四條。IMG_5260.MOV [80.68–81.73]：「SSTC」；IMG_5260.MOV [89.28–93.43]：「因為過去沒有同學能夠四條都寫完」；IMG_5260.MOV [94.74–100.12]：「最後那天我四十九分的同學都差了一點」。 ---
1f · 法援兩項測試

題目：
What are the two tests for legal aid application?

答案：
1. means test: The purpose of the "means test" is to assess the financial resources of the applicant. Under the Ordinary Legal Aid Scheme, the financial eligibility limit is $290,380 whereas that under the Supplementary Legal Aid Scheme is $1,451,900.
2. Merits test: The main purpose of the "merits test" is to determine whether an applicant has a reasonable claim or defence or whether the grant of legal aid to an applicant is justified. To this end, the applicant must provide all the information relevant to his or her case.

點解係咁 (English)：
Legal aid is publicly funded, so the Legal Aid Department must ration it. The means test checks whether the applicant can afford legal services: financial resources are monthly disposable income multiplied by 12 plus disposable capital, and the eligibility limits are $290,380 under the Ordinary Legal Aid Scheme and $1,451,900 under the Supplementary Legal Aid Scheme. The merits test checks whether the case is worth funding: the applicant must have a reasonable claim or defence with a reasonable chance of success, and must give the Director all relevant information. Both tests must be passed.

點解係咁（中文）：
法援係公帑資助，所以法律援助署要用兩個測試把關。經濟審查（means test）睇申請人負唔負擔得起法律服務：財政資源係每月可動用收入乘 12 再加可動用資產，普通計劃上限係 $290,380，輔助計劃上限係 $1,451,900。案情審查（merits test）睇案件值唔值得資助：申請人要有合理的申索或抗辯理由、有合理勝訴機會，並且要向署長提供所有相關資料。兩關都要過。

2a · 司法覆核理由，MC

題目：
The grounds of judicial review do NOT include:
A. illegality
B. irrationality
C. maladministration
D. procedural unfairness

答案：
C

點解係咁 (English)：
Judicial review has three recognised grounds: illegality (acting outside one's powers), irrationality (a decision so unreasonable that no reasonable authority could have made it), and procedural unfairness (breach of fair procedures). Maladministration is not a ground — it means poor administration, and that is investigated by the Ombudsman, not the courts. Judicial review examines whether a public body's decision was lawful, not whether the administration was efficient. So A, B and D are all genuine grounds, and only C is not.

點解係咁（中文）：
司法覆核有三個公認理由：越權（illegality，超出法定權力行事）、不合理（irrationality，決定不合理到無合理機關會作出）、程序不公（procedural unfairness，違反公平程序）。行政失當（maladministration）唔係理由——佢指行政上做得唔好，係申訴專員調查的範圍，唔係法院管的。司法覆核睇的是決定的過程合唔合法，唔係行政效率高唔高。所以 A、B、D 都係真正理由，只有 C 唔係。

🎤 老師口講重點（機器轉錄，僅供參考）：

  • 老師話行政失當唔係法院管，係申訴專員的範圍。IMG_5260.MOV [177.82–205.08]：「這個法院管不著為甚麼法院管不著 因為我們在香港政府的架構裏面有一個叫 Ombudsman」。 ---
2b · 邊條法例未經立法會通過，MC

題目：
Which of the following laws has NOT been passed in the Legislative Council in Hong Kong:-
A. Disability Discrimination Ordinance
B. Family Status Discrimination Ordinance
C. Race Discrimination Ordinance
D. Age Discrimination Ordinance

答案：
D

點解係咁 (English)：
Hong Kong has enacted anti-discrimination ordinances for disability, family status and race, but it has no Age Discrimination Ordinance. The teacher confirmed this in class: Hong Kong does not yet have an age discrimination ordinance. So D is the only law on the list that was never passed by the Legislative Council, while A, B and C are all existing ordinances.

點解係咁（中文）：
香港已經為殘疾、家庭崗位同種族制定咗反歧視條例，但未有年齡歧視條例。老師喺堂上確認過，香港暫時未有年齡歧視條例。所以 D 係四個選項入面唯一一條未經立法會通過的法例，A、B、C 都係現行條例。

  • 老師用殘疾、家庭崗位（懷孕）、種族做例子講解現行反歧視保障，再話香港暫時未有年齡歧視條例。IMG_5260.MOV [272.24–297.08]：「如果拿出來的時候 就會有race discrimination這是種族上的差別」；IMG_5260.MOV [297.08–305.24]：「了所以香港暫時認定是未有 會有年齡歧視的」（「會有」疑似「沒有」誤聽）。 ---
3a · 基本法第 104 條 — 宣誓人士

題目：
According to Article 104 of the Basic Law, when assuming office, the following persons must, in accordance with law, swear to uphold The Basic Law of the HKSAR of the PRC and swear allegiance to the HKSAR of PRC.

答案：
1. Chief Executive
2. principal officials
3. members of the Executive Council
4. members of the Legislative Council
5. judges of the courts at all levels and other members of the judiciary in HKSAR.

點解係咁 (English)：
Article 104 requires the holders of the most senior public offices to swear, when assuming office, to uphold the Basic Law and to swear allegiance to the HKSAR: the Chief Executive, principal officials, Executive Council members, Legislative Council members, and judges and other members of the judiciary. The oath binds those who exercise executive, legislative and judicial power to the constitutional order, so the list is simply the people at the top of each branch of government plus the judiciary.

點解係咁（中文）：
基本法第 104 條要求最高級公職人員就職時宣誓擁護基本法、效忠特區：行政長官、主要官員、行政會議成員、立法會議員，以及各級法院法官同其他司法人員。宣誓係要行使行政、立法、司法權力的人受憲制秩序約束，所以名單就係三權最高層加司法人員。

🎤 老師口講重點（機器轉錄，僅供參考）：

  • 老師話 3A 問的是重要人物，包括立法會九十位議員，寫到一個人就獲分；又講笑話 "swear" 聽落似鬧人。IMG_5260.MOV [306.42–336.30]：「重要人物剛才我們說過 行政立法會那些尊貴的議員我們有九十個」。

畫面未見獨立問句（如 "Who are…?"），題目欄只見上述引文，答案為下列名單。按畫面所見記錄，無補寫問句。 ---
3b · ICESCR 第 11 條，MC

題目：
Under Article 11 of the International Covenant on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights (ICESCR), which of the following right is NOT recognized: -
A. right to adequate food
B. right to same sex marriage
C. right to adequate clothing
D. right to be free from hunger.

答案：
B

點解係咁 (English)：
Article 11 of the ICESCR recognises the right to an adequate standard of living, including adequate food and adequate clothing, and the fundamental right to be free from hunger. It is a provision about material living standards, not about marriage. Same-sex marriage is therefore not a right under Article 11, so A, C and D are all rights that Article 11 does recognise, and only B is not.

點解係咁（中文）：
《經濟、社會及文化權利國際公約》第 11 條確認的是適當生活水準的權利，包括足夠食物、足夠衣物，以及免於飢餓的基本權利。呢條係講物質生活水準，唔係講婚姻。所以同性婚姻唔係第 11 條確認的權利，A、C、D 都係第 11 條確認的權利，只有 B 唔係。

  • 老師話用常識都答到係 B。IMG_5260.MOV [336.52–357.90]：「不過我們普通常識剛才同學已經獲分了 就說B」。 ---
4a · 盜竊罪定義／元素

題目：
What is the definition of theft offence under the Theft Ordinance? In other words, what are the criminal elements of the theft offence?

答案：
1. criminal behavior (Actus Reu): misappropriation of property belonging to another
2. criminal intent (Mens Rea): dishonesty plus intention of permanently depriving the other of the property.
S2, Cap.210: A person commits theft if he dishonestly appropriates property belonging to another with the intention of permanently depriving the other of it.

點解係咁 (English)：
Theft needs both actus reus (the prohibited act) and mens rea (the guilty mind), and the prosecution must prove every element beyond reasonable doubt. The actus reus is dishonestly appropriating property belonging to another; the mens rea is dishonesty plus the intention permanently to deprive the owner of it. Section 2(1) of the Theft Ordinance (Cap 210) states the whole definition in one sentence, which is why the answer lists four points: dishonesty, appropriation, property belonging to another, and intention to permanently deprive.

點解係咁（中文）：
盜竊罪要同時有 actus reus（被禁止的行為）同 mens rea（犯罪意圖），控方要毫無合理疑點咁證明每一個元素。行為方面係不誠實地挪佔屬於他人的財物；意圖方面係不誠實加上永久剝奪他人財物的意圖。《盜竊罪條例》（第 210 章）第 2(1) 條用一句講晒成個定義，所以答案列出四點：不誠實、挪佔、屬於他人的財物、永久剝奪的意圖。

🎤 老師口講重點（機器轉錄，僅供參考）：

  • 老師話要攞他人的物品、唔可以攞自己的，動機係 dishonesty 加永遠佔有；四點入面隨便寫到一點都會鬆手畀分。IMG_5260.MOV [357.90–379.96]：「就是拿了其他人的物品 一定要其他人的 如果自己拿自己的東西不可以……動機在法律上叫 dishonesty即是說你隱瞞 偷偷地拿別人的東西 你想永遠佔有」；IMG_5260.MOV [390.99–417.67]：「如果你隨便寫到一點 我就鬆手」。 ---
4b · Binding over order

題目：
What is a binding over order?

答案：
It is a preventive measure whereby the court requires a person to enter a recognizance, with or without sureties, in a fixed sum, to be of good behavior or to keep the peace for a period not exceeding three years.

點解係咁 (English)：
A binding-over order is preventive, not punitive. Instead of convicting and sentencing the person, the court requires them to enter a recognizance — to deposit a fixed sum of money with the court as security, with or without sureties — and to be of good behaviour or keep the peace for up to three years. The point is to prevent future trouble rather than to punish past conduct, which is why the order is about good behaviour for a period of time rather than a penalty.

點解係咁（中文）：
Binding over order 係預防措施，唔係懲罰。法庭唔係定罪判刑，而係要求當事人簽保（交一筆固定款項畀法庭做擔保，可以有擔保人、亦可以無），並且在不超過三年內守行為、保持和平。目的係防止將來出事，唔係懲罰過去的行為，所以重點係一段時間內的良好行為，而唔係罰則。

🎤 老師口講重點（機器轉錄，僅供參考）：

  • 老師話要交一筆錢畀法院、未來三年守行為；binding over 類似守行為，但要放低一筆錢喺法院作擔保。IMG_5260.MOV [477.44–497.14]：「你要交一些錢出來 給法院然後在未來三年 你是守行為的」；IMG_5260.MOV [518.70–533.22]：「你要擔保良好的行為 一段時間其實就是好像守行為 不過不是守行為 是一個binding over 類似的不過你擺錢去法院」。 ---
4c · 非禮 vs 強姦分別

題目：
What is the difference between the offence of indecent assault and rape?

答案：

Indecent assaultRape
1. Gender of Offendermale or femalemale only
2. Criminal intentwithout consentwithout consent
3. Criminal behaviorassault is indecentpenetration
4. Maximum penalty imprisonment10 yearslife
5. Source of LawS122, Cap.200S118, Cap.200

點解係咁 (English)：
Both offences require absence of consent, but they differ in four ways. First, only a man can commit rape, while indecent assault can be committed by a person of either sex. Second, rape requires penetration of the vagina by the penis, while indecent assault covers an indecent assault — a wide range of conduct from touching to non-penile sexual penetration. Third, the maximum penalty reflects that difference: life imprisonment for rape, 10 years for indecent assault. Fourth, they come from different sections of the Crimes Ordinance (Cap 200): section 118 for rape, section 122 for indecent assault. The comparison table in the answer is the table to memorise.

點解係咁（中文）：
兩罪都要未經同意，但有四方面分別。第一，只有男性可以犯強姦罪，非禮罪男女都可以犯。第二，強姦罪要有陰莖插入陰道，非禮罪係猥褻侵犯，範圍好闊，由觸摸到非陰莖插入的性侵犯都包括。第三，最高刑罰反映呢個分別：強姦罪終身監禁，非禮罪十年監禁。第四，兩罪出自《刑事罪行條例》（第 200 章）唔同條文：強姦罪第 118 條，非禮罪第 122 條。答案的對照表就係要背熟的表。

---

4d · 刑事舉證責任／標準

題目：
What is the burden of proof and standard of proof of a criminal charge?

答案：
1. Unless otherwise stated, the burden of proof lies in the Prosecution
2. Standard of proof for the Prosecution is that the Prosecution has to prove the case beyond reasonable doubt.

點解係咁 (English)：
In a criminal case the prosecution bears the burden of proof and must prove the defendant's guilt beyond reasonable doubt; the defendant is presumed innocent until proven guilty. This is the highest standard of proof in law, because a conviction can deprive a person of liberty, so the risk of a wrongful conviction must be kept very low. If there is doubt about any element of the offence, the prosecution has not made its case.

點解係咁（中文）：
刑事案件由控方負舉證責任，要毫無合理疑點咁證明被告有罪；被告在未被證明有罪之前，推定為無罪。呢個係法律上最高的舉證標準，因為定罪可以剝奪一個人的自由，所以錯判的風險要壓到最低。如果對罪行的任何元素有疑問，即係控方未能舉證。

---

5 · 合約五元素

題目：
What are the five elements to constitute a contract?

答案：
1. offer
2. acceptance
3. consideration
4. intention to create legal relations
5. (a) clear and certain terms and condition
(b) legal aim
(c) legal capacity

點解係咁 (English)：
A contract needs five elements. First, one side makes an offer and the other accepts it. Second, there must be consideration — value given in exchange, not "consideration" in the everyday sense of thoughtfulness. Third, both sides must intend to create legal relations, so a purely social promise does not count. Fourth, the terms must be clear and certain, the aim must be legal, and both sides must have legal capacity. If any element is missing, there is no binding contract.

點解係咁（中文）：
合約要五個元素。第一，一方提出要約，另一方接納。第二，要有約因（consideration）——即係交換的代價，唔係日常講的「體諒」。第三，雙方要有建立法律關係的意圖，純社交承諾唔計。第四，條款要清晰確定、目的要合法、雙方要有訂立合約的能力。缺任何一項，就唔係有約束力的合約。

🎤 老師口講重點（機器轉錄，僅供參考）：

  • 老師用買三文治做例子：有人畀嘢（offer）、你接納（acceptance）、你畀錢就係約因；法律上的 consideration 係 value（代價），唔係「體諒」；雙方要有建立法律關係的意圖；條款唔清晰，合約就唔成立。IMG_5260.MOV [537.98–567.38]：「contract 合約 很簡單的 買一份三文治 已經展示到合約的了因為有人給你東西 offer」；IMG_5260.MOV [597.96–621.30]：「在法律上面consideration是value 意思 即是我給錢你」；IMG_5260.MOV [622.80–652.58]：「大家都有一個意圖 我賣東西給你」。 ---
6a · 疏忽四元素

題目：
What are the four elements to constitute an act of negligence?

答案：
1. duty of care
2. breach of duty
3. causation
4. reasonably foreseeable

點解係咁 (English)：
Negligence needs four elements. First, the defendant must owe the claimant a duty of care. Second, the defendant must breach that duty by falling below the standard of a reasonable person. Third, the breach must cause the damage (the "but for" test). Fourth, the kind of damage must have been reasonably foreseeable. The classic illustration is Donoghue v Stevenson (1932): a manufacturer who sells ginger beer in a sealed bottle owes a duty to the ultimate consumer even though there is no contract between them, because the consumer is a "neighbour" whom the manufacturer can reasonably foresee will be injured by careless preparation.

點解係咁（中文）：
疏忽要四個元素。第一，被告對原告負有謹慎責任。第二，被告違反咗呢個責任，未達到合理人士的標準。第三，違反責任要造成損害（"but for" 因果測試）。第四，損害的種類要係合理可預見。經典例子係 Donoghue v Stevenson（1932 年）：生產商將薑啤裝喺密封樽出售，對最終消費者負有謹慎責任，即使兩者之間無合約關係，因為消費者係生產商合理可預見會因疏忽製備而受傷的「鄰人」。

🎤 老師口講重點（機器轉錄，僅供參考）：

  • 老師用 1932 年薑啤案做例子：樽入面有蝸牛，消費者要告生產商，雖然中間隔咗好多層，生產商仍然有責任。IMG_5260.MOV [701.76–716.52]：「我在課堂上講了一個經典例子三二年的例子」；IMG_5260.MOV [762.14–777.90]：「因為生產商 manufacturer他知道他生產這樣的製成品 喝的啤酒最終是那個consumer的使用者喝」；IMG_5260.MOV [777.90–807.88]：「雖然隔了很多層 但是他仍然是有這個責任」。 ---
6b · 民事舉證責任／標準

題目：
What is the burden of proof and standard of proof of a civil claim?

答案：
1. burden of proof lies on the plaintiff (claimant)
2. balance of probabilities

點解係咁 (English)：
In a civil claim the burden of proof lies on the plaintiff (the claimant), and the standard is the balance of probabilities — the court asks whether the claim is more likely than not true. This is a lower standard than the criminal "beyond reasonable doubt", because a civil case decides compensation between private parties rather than punishment by the state, so the law accepts a lower level of certainty.

點解係咁（中文）：
民事索償由原告（申索人）負舉證責任，標準係相對可能性的衡量——法庭問的是申索是否「較有可能屬實」。呢個標準低過刑事的「毫無合理疑點」，因為民事案件係私人之間爭賠償，唔係國家懲罰，所以法律接受較低的確定程度。

---

7a · 《時效條例》第 7 條 — 追討土地時限

題目：
From 1 July 1991 onwards, section 7 of the Limitation Ordinance set out the limitation of actions to recover land. What is the respective period specified for (i) Government land; and (ii) non-government land?

答案：
i. 60 years
ii. 12 years

點解係咁 (English)：
Section 7 of the Limitation Ordinance sets time limits for recovering land: 60 years for Government land and 12 years for non-government land. Limitation periods exist so that claims must be brought promptly while evidence is still fresh — the Ordinance sets different periods for different kinds of claim (for example, 3 years for personal injury and 6 years for tort). The teacher's point in class was that the period must fit the claim: a negligence claim cannot wait 12 years. Why the Ordinance gives Government land 60 years and non-government land 12 years is not directly explained in the course materials.

點解係咁（中文）：
《時效條例》第 7 條為追討土地設定時限：政府土地 60 年，非政府土地 12 年。時效期的作用係要申索及時提出，趁證據仲新鮮——條例對唔同種類的申索定咗唔同時限（例如人身傷害 3 年、侵權 6 年）。老師喺堂上話時限要配合申索種類：疏忽索償唔可以等 12 年。至於點解政府土地係 60 年、非政府土地係 12 年，課程材料未有直接說明。

🎤 老師口講重點（機器轉錄，僅供參考）：

  • 老師話 limitation 即係時間上的限制；政府土地 60 年，非政府土地 12 年；疏忽索償唔可以等 12 年，要盡快。IMG_5260.MOV [807.88–837.10]：「這個所謂limitation ordinance就是講時下 這個時間上面的限制」；IMG_5260.MOV [837.92–864.24]：「會不會60年這麼久當然不會 12年會不會都長」。 ---
7b · 逆權管有兩元素

題目：
What are the two elements for action of adverse possession in common law? [Not used]

答案：
The principles set out on adverse possession is as follows:
(1) If the law is to attribute possession of land to a person who can establish no paper title to possession, he must be shown to have both (a) factual possession and (b) the requisite intention to possess (animus possidendi):
(a) Factual possession signifies an appropriate degree of physical control. It must be a single and conclusive possession, though there can be a single possession exercised by or on behalf of several persons jointly. … The question what acts constitute a sufficient degree of exclusive physical control must depend on the circumstances…acts of possession done on parts of land
［畫面睇唔清／未拍到：(a) 段尾部在分頁處，介乎 "acts of possession done on parts of land" 與 (b) 段之間的句子未拍到，僅見零碎文字（"…title is sought may be evidence of possession of the whole."，部分被遮擋），未能完整記錄。］
(b) the animus possidendi involves the intention, in one's own name and on one's own behalf, to exclude the world at large, including the owner with the paper title if he be not himself the possessor, so far as is reasonably practicable and so far as the processes of the law will allow.

點解係咁 (English)：
Adverse possession needs two elements: factual possession — an appropriate degree of exclusive physical control over the land — and the intention to possess (animus possidendi). The 12-year period in the teacher's example matches the limitation period for recovering non-government land (Q7a): once a person has possessed the land adversely for 12 years, the paper owner's right to recover it is time-barred, so the land effectively becomes the possessor's. The teacher's hiking example makes it concrete: pitching tents and placing stones on a hillside plot, occupying it for 12 years.

點解係咁（中文）：
逆權管有要兩個元素：事實管有——對土地有適當程度的專有實際控制，以及管有的意圖（animus possidendi）。老師例子入面的 12 年，同第 7a 題追討非政府土地的 12 年時效期係同一回事：有人逆權佔用土地 12 年之後，紙面業主追討的權利就過咗時效，塊地實際上就歸佔用人。老師行山的例子好具體：喺山邊一塊地搭帳篷、擺石頭，佔據 12 年。

🎤 老師口講重點（機器轉錄，僅供參考）：

8 · 遺囑形式要件

題目：
What are the four basic requirements with regard to the formalities that must be followed when a will is made are set out in section 5 of the Wills Ordinance?

答案：
s.5(1) of the Wills Ordinance (Cap.30):
1. in writing, and signed by the testator
2. signature of the testator
3. in the presence of two or more witnesses present at the same time
4. each witness either signs the will or acknowledges his signature in the presence of the testator

點解係咁 (English)：
A will takes effect only after the testator has died, so the testator can no longer be asked what they intended — the formalities are safeguards against forgery and dispute. Section 5(1) of the Wills Ordinance (Cap 30) requires four things: the will must be in writing and signed by the testator; the testator's signature; the signature made in the presence of two or more witnesses present at the same time; and each witness either signing the will or acknowledging their signature in the presence of the testator. The class material shows why this matters with the Chan Chun Chuen case (HCCC 182/2012): Chan was found guilty by a jury of forging a will purporting to be that of the late Mrs Nina Wang and using the forgery to claim he was the true beneficiary of her estate — forgery of a will can carry up to 14 years' imprisonment per offence under the Crimes Ordinance.

點解係咁（中文）：
遺囑要等立遺囑人死咗先生效，到時已經無辦法再問佢本來有咩意圖——所以形式要件係防偽同防爭拗的保障。《遺囑條例》（第 30 章）第 5(1) 條要求四樣嘢：遺囑要書面、由立遺囑人簽署；立遺囑人的簽署；簽署要喺兩名或以上同時在場的見證人面前作出；每名見證人要喺立遺囑人面前簽署遺囑，或確認自己的簽署。堂上用 Chan Chun Chuen 案（HCCC 182/2012）講解點解要咁嚴：Chan 被陪審團裁定偽造一份聲稱係已故 Mrs Nina Wang 的遺囑，並利用偽造遺囑聲稱自己係遺產的真正受益人——根據《刑事罪行條例》，偽造遺囑每項罪行最高可判監 14 年。

🎤 老師口講重點（機器轉錄，僅供參考）：

  • 老師話寫遺囑有幾個步驟，而且要有人見證，見證人就係 witness。IMG_5260.MOV [1076.32–1097.50]：「這個遺囑的制定有幾個程序呢 或者有幾個步驟呢 它是要有人在旁邊見證的」；IMG_5260.MOV [1097.50–1118.20]：「我們稱做 witness」。

題目措辭 "are set out" 按畫面原文記錄。 ---
9a · 離婚單一理由及五個事實

題目：
According to section 11A of the Matrimonial Causes Ordinance (Cap.179), the court hearing a petition for divorce shall not hold the marriage to have broken down irretrievably unless the petitioner satisfies the court one or more of the five facts. What are the five facts?

答案：
(a) the respondent has committed adultery and the petitioner finds it intolerable to live with the respondent.
(b) the respondent has behaved in such a way that the petitioner cannot reasonably be expected to live with the respondent.
(c) the parties to the marriage have lived apart for a continuous period of at least 1 year immediately preceding the presentation of the petition and the respondent consents to a decree's being granted;
(d) the parties to the marriage have lived apart for a continuous period of at least 2 years immediately preceding the presentation of the petition;
(e) the respondent has deserted the petitioner for a continuous period of at least 1 year immediately preceding the presentation of the petition.

點解係咁 (English)：
Under section 11A of the Matrimonial Causes Ordinance there is only one ground for divorce: that the marriage has broken down irretrievably. The five facts are not five separate grounds — they are the five ways of proving that single ground, and the petitioner only needs to satisfy the court of one or more of them. In this course the five facts are: adultery (with the petitioner finding it intolerable to live with the respondent), unreasonable behaviour, consensual one-year separation, two-year living apart, and one-year desertion. The key phrase to remember is that the marriage is irretrievably broken: "irretrievably" means beyond repair, so the court is really asking whether the marriage has failed beyond saving.

點解係咁（中文）：
根據《婚姻訴訟條例》第 11A 條，離婚只有一個理由：婚姻已經破裂到無法挽回。五個事實唔係五個獨立理由，而係證明呢一個理由的五種方法，申請人只需要令法庭信納其中一項或以上。喺呢科，五個事實係：通姦（並且申請人無法忍受同答辯人共同生活）、不合理行為、雙方同意分居一年、分居兩年、遺棄一年。關鍵短語要記住：婚姻「不可挽回、已經破碎」——「無法挽回」意思係無得修補，法庭真正問的是婚姻係咪已經無得救。

🎤 老師口講重點（機器轉錄，僅供參考）：

  • 老師話寫到一個事實就可以，用 "不可挽救、已經破碎" 呢句做關鍵。IMG_5260.MOV [1198.38–1216.82]：「離婚的婚姻關係是不可挽救的，已經是破碎了」；IMG_5260.MOV [1225.84–1245.18]：「這五個例子 你只要寫到一個就可以了」。 ---
9b · 《監護權條例》第 3 條 — 兒童最佳利益

題目：
According to section 3(1) of Guardianship of Minors Ordinance, Cap. 13, in relation to the custody or upbringing of a minor, and in relation to the administration of any property belonging to or held in trust for a minor or the application of the income of any such property (a) in any proceedings before any court, the court (i) shall regard the best interests of the minor as the first and paramount consideration and in having such regard shall give due consideration to the following (A) and (B) and including all the material information, what is the material information for consideration?

答案：
Section 3(1) of Guardianship of Minors Ordinance, Cap. 13:
In relation to the custody or upbringing of a minor, and in relation to the administration of any property belonging to or held in trust for a minor or the application of the income of any such property—
(a) in any proceedings before any court (whether or not a court as defined in section 2) the court—
(i) shall regard the best interests of the minor as the first and paramount consideration and in having such regard shall give due consideration to—
(A) the views of the minor if, having regard to the age and understanding of the minor and to the circumstances of the case, it is practicable to do so; and
(B) any material information including any report of the Director of Social Welfare available to the court at the hearing; and
(ii) shall not take into consideration whether, from any other point of view, the claim of the father, in respect of such custody, upbringing, administration or application is superior to that of the mother, or the claim of the mother is superior to that of the father;

List of factors

The checklist states that the following should be considered:
(a) the ascertainable wishes and feelings of the child concerned considered in the light of his age and understanding;
(b) the child's physical, emotional and educational needs;
(c) the nature of the relationship of the child with each of the child's parents and with other persons;
(d) The likely effect on the child of any change in the child's circumstances;
(e) The child's age, maturity sex, social and cultural background and any other characteristics which the court considers relevant;
(f) The attitude to the child, and to the responsibilities of parenthood, demonstrated by each of the child's parents
(g) Any harm which the child has suffered or is at risk of suffering;
(h) Any family violence involving the child or a member of the child's family;
(i) How capable each of the child's parents, and any other person in relation to whom the court considers the question to be relevant, is of meeting his needs;
(j) (a broader formulation along the lines of) the practical difficulty and expense of a child having contact with a parent and whether that difficulty or expense will substantially affect the child's right to maintain personal relations and direct contact with both parents on a regular basis;
(k) The range of powers available to the court under this Ordinance in the proceedings in question;
(l) Any other fact or circumstance that the court thinks is relevant.

點解係咁 (English)：
Section 3(1) of the Guardianship of Minors Ordinance (Cap 13) makes the best interests of the minor the first and paramount consideration in any proceedings about a child's custody, upbringing or property. In having that regard the court must give due consideration to (A) the views of the minor (having regard to age and understanding, where practicable) and (B) any material information, including any report of the Director of Social Welfare available at the hearing; and the court must not weigh whether the father's claim is superior to the mother's, or vice versa. The welfare checklist is how the court works that principle out in practice: the child's wishes and feelings, physical, emotional and educational needs, relationships with parents and others, the effect of any change, age and background, each parent's attitude, any harm suffered or at risk, family violence, each parent's capacity to meet the child's needs, the practical difficulty of contact, the court's powers, and any other relevant fact. The checklist is long, so the teacher's advice was to master one item well — the child's needs and wishes — rather than trying to memorise all twelve.

點解係咁（中文）：
《監護權條例》（第 13 章）第 3(1) 條規定，喺任何關於未成年人管養、教養或財產的法律程序中，法庭要將未成年人的最佳利益視為首要及最重要考慮。法庭考慮時要適當顧及 (A) 未成年人本身的意見（視乎年齡同理解能力，如可行的話）同 (B) 任何重要資料，包括社會福利署署長在聆訊時可提供的報告；法庭亦唔可以考慮父親的主張係咪優於母親，或者母親的主張係咪優於父親。福利清單就係法庭實踐呢個原則的方法：兒童的意願同感受、身體、情感同教育需要、與父母及其他人的關係、環境改變的影響、年齡同背景、每位父母的態度、已經受過或可能受到的傷害、家庭暴力、每位父母滿足兒童需要的能力、接觸子女的實際困難、法庭的權力，以及任何其他相關事實。清單好長，老師建議唔使背晒十二項，掌握好其中一項——兒童的需要同意願——就夠。

🎤 老師口講重點（機器轉錄，僅供參考）：

  • 老師話 welfare checklist 好長，背一兩項就夠，講到兒童的需要同意願；「first and paramount」即係最重要；又講到 custody（管養權）唔係監護權。IMG_5260.MOV [1249.66–1283.74]：「這個所謂welfare checklist 很長的 你就不用背全了」；IMG_5260.MOV [1283.74–1304.82]：「要記住其中最最重要的 是什麼 叫做first and paramount 即是最重要」；IMG_5260.MOV [1310.26–1338.36]：「這個所謂custody custody的意思就是管養權 不是監護權」。
⚠️ 注意：
問句尾部（"what is the material information for consideration?"）同條文與清單之間的銜接文字（"List of factors"／"The checklist states that the following should be considered:"）已由課堂相片補齊（2026 年 11 月 18 日）；清單 (a)–(l) 已確認，(k) 項按錄片摘錄記錄，相片無推翻。
答案 (e) 項原文為 "The child's age, maturity sex, social and cultural background and any other characteristics which the court considers relevant;"，如畫面所示記錄。
答案 (j) 項原文為 "(a broader formulation along the lines of) the practical difficulty and expense of a child having contact with a parent and whether that difficulty or expense will substantially affect the child's right to maintain personal relations and direct contact with both parents on a regular basis;"，如畫面所示記錄。 ---
10 · 公司／合夥／社團的分別

題目：
What is the main difference among the following? (1) a private company limited by share incorporated under Company Ordinance (2) a partnership (3) a society formed under Societies Ordinance

答案：
1. extent of liability: limited liability for limited company while unlimited company bears unlimited liabilities.
2. ownership of landed property: limited companies can hold landed property while society and partnership cannot hold landed property.
3. legal capacity: limited company has legal capacity while society and partnership do not have legal capacity.
4. legal proceedings: limited company can sue and be sued by itself while society and partnership does not have such capacity.

點解係咁 (English)：
The four differences all flow from one key idea: a private company limited by shares is a separate legal person, while a partnership and a society are not. Because the company has its own legal personality and legal capacity, it can hold landed property in its own name and can sue and be sued by itself, and its members' liability is limited to their shares — the company's debts are the company's, not the shareholders'. A partnership and a society have no separate legal personality, so they cannot hold landed property or sue and be sued in their own name, and their members bear the consequences personally. As the teacher put it in class, in a partnership the problems fall on you personally, whereas a company folds as the company's business.

點解係咁（中文）：
四個分別都係由一個關鍵概念出嚟：私人股份有限公司係獨立法人，合夥同社團唔係。因為公司有獨立法人地位同法律能力，佢可以用自己的名義持有土地、自己告人同被人告，成員的責任只限於股份——公司的債係公司嘅，唔係股東嘅。合夥同社團無獨立法人地位，所以唔可以用自己的名義持有土地、告人或被人告，出事要成員自己承擔。用老師喺堂上的講法，合夥出事係你自己孭，公司執笠係公司嘅事。

🎤 老師口講重點（機器轉錄，僅供參考）：

  • 老師話合夥出咗事就要自己孭、自己負責任；公司唔同，公司倒閉係公司的事，因為公司係一個獨立的個體。IMG_5260.MOV [1375.78–1396.14]：「如果是合夥做生意 你出事了 你自己要承擔 你自己要負責任」；IMG_5260.MOV [1396.14–1416.34]：「如果是一間公司 公司倒閉 是公司的事 因為公司是一個獨立的個體」。
⚠️ 注意：
答案第 1 點 "unlimited company"（無限公司）已由課堂相片核實，確係文件本身的寫法——對照三者比較嚟講語義上奇怪，但文件就係咁寫，保留原文，未作改動。 ---
11 · 連續性合約 — "4-18" 規則

題目：
An employee is qualified for all the benefits (e.g. Rest days, Maternity leave, sickness allowance, etc.) and protections of the Employment Ordinance unless he is in continuous employment (s.3 and s.75). What is the meaning of "continuous employment" under the EO?

答案：
To qualify as an employee under a "continuous contract", the employee must have been continuously employed for a minimum duration of four consecutive weeks for at least 18 hours a week.

點解係咁 (English)：
A "continuous contract" is defined by the "4-18" rule: the employee must have been continuously employed for a minimum of four consecutive weeks, for at least 18 hours a week. Only employees under a continuous contract qualify for the full range of Employment Ordinance benefits and protections named in the question — rest days, maternity leave, sickness allowance and the rest. The test is stated in weeks and hours, so what matters is whether that pattern of work is met; full-time or part-time is not part of the test.

點解係咁（中文）：
「連續性合約」由「四一八」規則界定：僱員要連續受僱最少四個星期，每星期至少 18 小時。只有連續性合約下的僱員先享有題目列出的《僱傭條例》全部福利同保障——休息日、產假、疾病津貼等等。呢個測試係用星期數同工時嚟講，關鍵係工作模式係咪符合四星期、每星期 18 小時；全職定兼職唔係測試的內容。

⚠️ 注意：
題目以 "unless" 作問法（如文件原文記錄）；答案的 4 星期／18 小時規則如上。 ---

版本 Version 2.9.1

點樣用呢個站溫書？

MC 考「認得 + 分得清」，Short Q 考「Issue → Concept → Analysis → Conclusion」。兩種題型，兩套打法。

① MC 打法：分清易混位

出卷最鍾意考對比：刑事 vs 民事舉證標準、襲擊 vs 毆打、疏忽四元素、DCRVO 三種禁制令、監護令條件。MC 練習每題即對答案 + 解釋點解其他選項錯。

② Short Q 打法：ICAC 四步

每條 Short Q 都跟呢個骨：Issue（爭議係咩）→ Concept（邊條法例／咩原則＋條文編號）→ Analysis（套返落事實）→ Conclusion（立場）。練習區有範答同畀分點，自己寫完先開嚟對。

③ 案例係分數來源

Q1–Q20 全部係老師揀嘅案例，Short Q 好可能就係改少少事實再問。案例庫每單都有 Issue / 法例 / 結果，背熟「案例名 + 一句判決」已經贏一半。

L1–L2 香港法律制度根基 · MC 高頻
  • Sources of Law (法律來源)
    The hierarchy is: Basic Law is supreme, followed by Statute Law — Ordinances and Subsidiary Legislation — then Case Law, comprising Common Law and Equity, and Chinese Customary Law on matters such as New Territories land. Basic Law Article 8 preserves the laws previously in force, while Basic Law Article 18 lists the laws in force in the HKSAR.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    法律位階由高至低排列，附屬立法唔可以超越主體條例，否則屬 ultra vires（越權）而無效。答題時唔好將位階倒轉。
  • Common Law & Equity (普通法與衡平法)
    Common Law is judge-made law developed through precedent in an adversarial system, where the judge is passive and neutral. Equity developed to mitigate the rigidity of the common law, providing fair remedies where strict legal rights would produce injustice. Where they conflict, Equity prevails.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    普通法靠先例、法官被動中立；衡平法補救普通法嘅僵化。兩者衝突時以衡平法優先，但要先分清邊一方持有 legal interest（法律權益）、邊一方持有 equitable interest（衡平權益）。
    📌 Case: Wong Chim Ying v Cheng Kam Wing
    Facts: Matrimonial home bought with husband's money but registered in wife's name. Wife later sold it.
    Holding: Common law recognized wife as legal owner, but Equity recognized husband's equitable interest. Equitable interest prevailed.
    🇭🇰 中文：男方出錢買樓但登記女方名下，女方其後賣樓。普通法重形式，衡平法重實質公義，最終衡平權益勝出。Short Q 要寫齊邊個出錢、登記喺邊個名下、點解 Equity 介入。
  • Rule of Law (法治)
    Dicey's Three Points: (1) Supremacy of Law — no one is punishable except for a distinct breach of law, and government power must have a legal basis. (2) Equality before the Law — every person, including officials, is subject to the ordinary law and ordinary courts. (3) Constitutional principles derive from judicial decisions — rights are protected through remedies given by courts in individual cases.
    Modern views add that government acts need a legal basis, discretionary power must be restricted and reviewable, and an independent judiciary must be able to review government action.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    戴雪三點：(1) 法律至上 —— 除非明確違法，否則無人可受罰；(2) 法律面前人人平等，包括官員；(3) 憲法原則源自司法判決。現代觀點再強調限制酌情權同司法覆核。
  • Separation of Powers (三權分立)
    State power is divided into the Legislature which makes, amends and repeals laws, the Executive which implements and enforces laws, and the Judiciary which adjudicates disputes and interprets laws. The doctrine works through checks and balances — for example, judicial review lets courts check executive action, preventing any one branch from abusing power.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    立法制訂法律、行政執行法律、司法裁斷爭議，三權互相制衡。引用條文要準：Basic Law Articles 43–65（行政）、Articles 66–79（立法）、Articles 80–96（司法）。
  • Judicial Independence (司法獨立)
    In the broad sense, it means the judiciary is free from interference by the executive and legislature as an institution. In the narrow sense, it means an individual judge is free from interference in decision-making in a particular case.
    Constitutional safeguards include Basic Law Article 85 — courts exercise judicial power independently, Article 88 — appointment on the recommendation of the Judicial Officers Recommendation Commission (Cap 92), Article 89 — security of tenure, removal only for inability or misbehaviour, and Article 90 — the Chief Justice is appointed and removed with LegCo endorsement. Guiding principle: "Justice must not only be done but must also be seen to be done."
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    廣義係司法機關整體不受干擾，狹義係個別法官判案不受干擾。就算實際無偏袒，表面偏頗 appearance of bias 都足以損害公信力。
  • Court Structure (法院架構)
    From the top: Court of Final Appeal (CFA) → Court of Appeal (CA) → Court of First Instance (CFI) — the CA and CFI together form the High Court → District Court (DC): civil jurisdiction up to $3,000,000 and criminal sentencing up to 7 years' imprisonment → Magistrates' Court: up to 2 years' imprisonment and a $100,000 fine → Small Claims Tribunal: claims up to $75,000, with no legal representation to keep proceedings cheap and informal.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    數字係畀分點，要背齊：區域法院民事 $3M / 刑事 7 年、裁判法院 2 年 / $100,000、小額錢債 $75,000 兼唔准律師。另有少年法庭、勞資審裁處、土地審裁處、死因裁判法庭、家事法庭。
  • Basic Law Article 158 (基本法第 158 條 · 解釋權)
    The power of interpretation of the Basic Law is vested in the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (NPCSC). HKSAR courts are authorised to interpret on their own, in adjudicating cases, provisions within the limits of the Region's autonomy.
    But if a provision concerns affairs which are the responsibility of the Central People's Government or the relationship between the Central Authorities and the Region, and its interpretation affects the judgment, the CFA must, before making its final judgment, seek an interpretation from the NPCSC, and must follow that interpretation. Related: Basic Law Article 159 — the power of amendment belongs to the NPC.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    解釋權歸人大常委。自治範圍內條文法院可自行解釋；涉及中央事務或中央與特區關係，先要喺終局判決前提請釋法。唔好同第 159 條修改權撈亂。
  • National Security Law (《香港國安法》)
    It creates four categories of offence: Secession, Subversion, Terrorist Activities and Collusion with a Foreign Country or External Elements. The local Safeguarding National Security Ordinance 2024 adds offences including Treason, Insurrection, offences relating to State Secrets, Sabotage and External Interference.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    國安法四罪：分裂國家、顛覆國家政權、恐怖活動、勾結外國或境外勢力。2024 年《維護國家安全條例》再加叛國、叛亂、國家秘密、破壞活動、境外干預。
  • Legislative Process (立法程序)
    A bill passes through First Reading → Second Reading → Committee Stage → Third Reading, then is signed by the Chief Executive and gazetted before taking effect. Subsidiary legislation must stay within the power conferred by its parent Ordinance, otherwise it is ultra vires and invalid. Legislation is in principle not retrospective.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    一讀、二讀、委員會階段、三讀，再經行政長官簽署刊憲生效。附屬立法唔可以超越主體法例授權；法例原則上無追溯力。
Social Work Link（社工連結）： Social Workers Registration Ordinance, Cap 505, s.17 — 被裁定干犯令專業聲譽受損嘅罪行，註冊局可拒絕註冊。所以國安法唔係「同社工無關」：刑事定罪會直接影響註冊資格同專業前途。
Short Q 出題陷阱 / 高分位 — L1–L2
  • Judicial Independence 要分開寫 broad sense 同 narrow sense，再逐條引 Basic Law Articles 85, 88, 89, 90，淨寫「法官獨立」冇分。
  • Article 158 陷阱係次序：before final judgment 提請，而且只限 central affairs / Central–Region relationship 條文；自治範圍內條文法院可自行解釋。
  • Court Structure 要寫數字：District Court $3M / 7 years、Magistrates' Court 2 years / $100,000、Small Claims Tribunal $75,000 / no lawyers。
  • 引 Wong Chim Ying v Cheng Kam Wing 要寫齊 Facts + Holding 同 Equity prevails，淨寫案例名唔攞分。
  • Rule of Law 要寫 Dicey 原文用語 Supremacy of Law / Equality before the Law，再加 modern views 先顯得完整。
L3 刑事法 Criminal Law元素題必考
  • Functions of Criminal Law & Prosecution (刑事法功能與檢控)
    Criminal law protects society and maintains order through deterrence, incapacitation, rehabilitation and retribution. The process is: arrest by the police → prosecution by the Department of Justice → trial by the court. The prosecution must prove every element of the offence — Actus Reus + Mens Rea.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    刑事法透過阻嚇、隔離、更生、報應保護社會。社工答題第一步永遠係拆元素，唔好一開始就講應唔應該罰。
  • Burden of Proof & Standard of Proof (舉證責任與標準)
    In criminal cases the prosecution must prove guilt beyond reasonable doubt — the highest standard, because the defendant's liberty is at stake. In civil cases the standard is only the balance of probabilities — more likely than not. This rests on the Presumption of Innocence: the accused is presumed innocent until proven guilty, so the accused does not have to prove his own innocence.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    刑事要無合理疑點，民事只需相對可能性。MC 最鍾意將兩個標準對調出題，見到 civil case 用 beyond reasonable doubt 即係錯。
  • Actus Reus (犯罪行為)
    The Actus Reus is the prohibited act specified by the offence, and it can also consist of a failure to act — an omission — where there is a legal duty to act. There is no general duty to rescue. A duty may arise from statute, contract, voluntary assumption of care, or creating a danger. Local example: OAPO Cap 212, s.27 imposes a duty on persons responsible for a child.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    一般原則係「唔救人本身唔犯法」。只有當法律責任存在，先會因不作為入罪。
    📌 Case: R v Miller — Duty Arising from Creating a Danger
    Facts: Squatter fell asleep smoking, started fire, woke up but didn't extinguish or call fire brigade. He simply moved to another room and went back to sleep.
    Holding: Once you create a danger and become aware of it, you have a duty to act. His failure to act formed the actus reus.
    🇭🇰 中文：責任唔係嚟自「佢係屋主」，而係嚟自「危險係佢造成 + 佢知情」。
    📌 Case: R v Stone & Dobinson — Voluntary Assumption of Care
    Facts: Couple took in anorexic relative, failed to summon help. Her condition deteriorated badly and she died.
    Holding: Voluntary assumption of care creates a legal duty. Their gross failure to act made them liable for manslaughter.
    🇭🇰 中文：照顧關係一旦成立，「我咩都冇做」唔係抗辯，反而正正係入罪基礎。
  • Causation (因果關係)
    The prosecution must prove the defendant's act caused the prohibited result. Step 1 — Factual causation: the 'but-for' test: but for the defendant's act, would the result have occurred? Step 2 — Legal causation: the defendant's act must remain an operative and substantial cause of the result.
    The chain can be broken by a novus actus interveniens — a free, deliberate and informed intervening act by a third party or the victim — but ordinary or even negligent medical treatment normally does not break the chain; only abnormal treatment will.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    先考「若非」測試，再考法律因果。一般甚至疏忽嘅醫療處理通常唔斷鏈，只有異常醫療處理先會斷鏈。
    📌 Case: R v Smith — Chain NOT Broken
    Facts: Stabbed victim dropped multiple times, given wrong treatment.
    Holding: Chain NOT broken, original wound still operative cause. Defendant remained liable for the death.
    🇭🇰 中文：醫療失誤就算幾差，只要原傷勢仍在發揮作用，介入行為唔會自動斷鏈。
    📌 Case: R v Jordan — Chain BROKEN
    Facts: Victim given large dose of drug he was intolerant to while recovering in hospital, and died from that reaction.
    Holding: Abnormal medical treatment BROKE the chain. It amounted to a novus actus interveniens; defendant was not liable for the death.
    🇭🇰 中文：同 R v Smith 對讀係必考位 — 分別唔係「有冇醫療失誤」，而係失誤去到 abnormal 程度、令原傷勢唔再係 operative cause 未。
    📌 Case: R v Pagett — Reasonable Self-Defence Does Not Break the Chain
    Facts: Used hostage as a shield, police shot hostage while returning fire in self-defence.
    Holding: Reasonable act of self-defence doesn't break chain; deliberate third-party act might. Defendant was liable for manslaughter.
    🇭🇰 中文：被迫、合理嘅反應係 foreseeable response，唔會斷鏈；死亡源於被告迫使對峙嘅行為。
  • Mens Rea (犯罪意圖)
    The Mens Rea is the mental element, in three descending levels: (1) Intention — the defendant aims at or knows the result is virtually certain. (2) Recklessness — the defendant foresees a risk and unjustifiably takes it. (3) Negligence — the defendant falls below the standard of the reasonable person, without necessarily foreseeing the risk; criminal liability usually requires gross negligence.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    意圖最高、罔顧次之、疏忽最低。Short Q 要按罪行要求指出需要邊一級 mens rea，唔好籠統寫「有意圖」就算。
  • Defences (抗辯)
    Common defences negating liability include Age — a child under 10 bears no criminal liability, Insanity, Automatism, Intoxication, Duress & Necessity and Self-Defence. Each defence has its own elements and evidential requirements; apply each element to the facts.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    唔係「提出咗就脫罪」。每種抗辯都有自己嘅元素同舉證要求，要逐項套事實分析，結論先有分。
    📌 Case: HKSAR v Shum Man Fai (2021) — Self-Defence: Two Limbs
    Facts / Rule: Self-defence must satisfy two limbs — (1) Necessity (honest belief), (2) Reasonableness (proportionate force).
    Holding: (1) Necessity — defendant honestly believed force was necessary to defend himself or another. (2) Reasonableness — force used was reasonable and proportionate to the threat faced. The force must not be retaliatory.
    🇭🇰 中文：自衛兩肢：先寫 honest belief（主觀），再寫 proportionate force（客觀），最後檢查有冇 retaliation 成分。威脅過咗再出手，兩肢都唔成立。
  • Classification of Offences & Theft (罪行分類與盜竊)
    Offences may be summary, indictable — serious indictable offences are tried in the CFI before a jury — or either-way. Theft Ordinance, Cap 210, s.2(1) — theft has four elements: dishonestly, appropriates, property belonging to another, with the intention of permanently depriving.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    盜竊四元素缺一不可：不誠實地、挪佔、屬於他人嘅財產、意圖永久剝奪。
答題骨（老師 L3 原稿）+ Short Q 出題陷阱 / 高分位 — L3 Criminal Law
  • 固定四步：① Identify the Issue ② Relevant Legal Concepts ③ Analysis（用概念套事實，有冇抗辯如 consent 同意？）④ Conclusion（講明立場）。
  • Causation 一定要寫齊 'but-for' test 同 novus actus interveniens，再用 R v Smith（not broken）對比 R v Jordan（abnormal treatment broke the chain）。
  • Omissions 先要指出 legal duty 來源：R v Miller 係 created the danger、R v Stone & Dobinson 係 voluntary assumption of care，冇 duty 就冇 actus reus。
  • Self-Defence 要逐肢寫 HKSAR v Shum Man Fai (2021) 嘅 necessity（honest belief）+ reasonableness（proportionate force），並明言 force must not be retaliatory。
  • 舉證標準唔好寫錯：criminal = beyond reasonable doubt，civil = balance of probabilities。
L4 成人法：家暴・OAPO・DCRVO社工實務高頻
  • Offences Against the Person Ordinance, Cap 212 (《侵害人身罪條例》第 212 章)
    The Offences Against the Person Ordinance, Cap 212 grades offences against the person by the seriousness of the harm and the offender's mental element. s.40 common assault — maximum 1 year; s.39 assault occasioning actual bodily harm (ABH) — 3 years; s.19 wounding or inflicting grievous bodily harm (GBH) — 3 years; s.17 GBH with malice and with arms — life imprisonment. At the top of the scale, s.2 murder carries life imprisonment, and s.7 manslaughter carries life imprisonment and a fine.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    Cap 212 按傷害嚴重程度同犯罪意圖分級。背刑罰要連條文一齊背：s.40 普通襲擊 1 年、s.39 ABH 3 年、s.19 GBH 3 年、s.17 惡意加武器 GBH 終身、s.2 謀殺終身、s.7 誤殺終身兼罰款。MC 最鍾意將 s.39 / s.19 / s.17 嘅刑罰對調出題。
  • Assault & Battery (襲擊與毆打)
    Assault is a display of threat causing the victim to apprehend immediate unlawful violence — no physical contact is needed, only that the victim anticipates force about to be used. Battery is the actual, intentional and unlawful use of force on another person. Common assault under s.40 can be committed by either form where there are no aggravating features. The distinction matters in analysis: identify first whether contact occurred, then grade the resulting harm as ABH or GBH.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    Assault 睇「預期」—— 令對方合理相信武力即將被使用，唔使掂到；Battery 睇「接觸」—— 實際施加非法武力。Short Q 分析次序：先分有冇接觸，再分傷害係 ABH 定 GBH，最後先落條文同刑罰。
  • Ill-treatment or Neglect of a Child — OAPO s.27 (虐待或忽略兒童)
    OAPO Cap 212, s.27 criminalises the ill-treatment or neglect of a child, with a maximum penalty ranging from 3 to 10 years' imprisonment. Although placed in the Adult Law lecture, this provision is the bridge to Child Law in L5: the same section is used to prosecute wilful assault, ill-treatment, neglect, abandonment or exposure of a child causing unnecessary suffering or injury to health. A social worker must therefore know s.27 in both contexts — as a serious offence against the person, and as a core child-protection provision.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    s.27 虐待／忽略兒童最高 3 至 10 年，係 L4 同 L5 之間嘅橋樑條文。L5 會再深入講構成元素；呢度先記住刑罰範圍同佢屬於 Cap 212。
  • Sexual Offences — Crimes Ordinance (《刑事罪行條例》性罪行)
    Under the Crimes Ordinance, s.118 rape carries life imprisonment, while s.122 indecent assault carries a maximum of 10 years. Rape and indecent assault must not be confused: they differ in the act involved and in the maximum penalty. In a domestic or intimate-partner context, forced sex after a refusal may therefore engage criminal liability under s.118 in addition to any civil remedy under the DCRVO — the two tracks are separate and can run together.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    強姦 s.118 終身、非禮 s.122 最高 10 年，唔好撈亂。婚姻或伴侶關係唔係免責理由；拒絕之後強迫性交，要同時諗刑事 s.118 同民事 DCRVO 兩條路。
    📌 Discussion Case: Ho Mai and Mei Li (slides)
    Facts: Ho Mai and Mei Li had been married for 10 years. There was verbal abuse in the marriage, and Ho Mai forced sex on Mei Li after she had refused. Their daughter overheard what happened and told the school social worker.
    Issues / Holding points: The facts raise (1) whether forced sex after refusal amounts to rape under Crimes Ordinance s.118; (2) whether the verbal abuse and forced sex amount to molestation justifying a non-molestation order under DCRVO Cap 189 s.3; and (3) the school social worker's role on receiving the daughter's disclosure — safety, support and referral.
    🇭🇰 中文：結婚 10 年、言語虐待、拒絕後強迫性交、女兒聽到後話畀學校社工知。呢個係課堂討論情境，唔係判例；答題要分開刑事（s.118）同民事（DCRVO）兩條分析線，再加社工收到披露後嘅處理，唔好當成有判決嘅案例嚟引。
  • Domestic and Cohabitation Relationships Violence Ordinance, Cap 189 — Civil Remedy (《家庭及同居關係暴力條例》第 189 章・民事補救)
    The Domestic and Cohabitation Relationships Violence Ordinance, Cap 189 (DCRVO) provides a civil remedy for victims of domestic and cohabitation relationship violence, in contrast to the criminal route under Cap 212. Its centrepiece is the non-molestation order under s.3(1)(a) for an adult applicant and s.3(1)(b) for a specified minor. Under s.3(1A), the court may also direct the respondent to attend a programme aimed at changing the attitude and behaviour that led to the molestation. A civil injunction can be sought without waiting for a criminal prosecution or conviction.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    DCRVO 係民事補救，唔使等刑事檢控或定罪先申請到。不騷擾令：成人 s.3(1)(a)、指明未成年人 s.3(1)(b)；s.3(1A) 可命令答辯人參加改變態度行為嘅課程。答題要寫明申請人係成人定 specified minor，先揀得啱 sub-section。
  • Exclusion & Entry Orders; Court Considerations; Power of Arrest (遷出令／重返令・法院考慮・逮捕授權)
    Beyond a non-molestation order, s.3(1)(c)(i) empowers the court to make an exclusion or entry order for an adult, and s.3(1)(c)(ii) does the same for a specified minor — excluding the respondent from, or allowing the applicant to re-enter, the shared home. In deciding whether and how to exercise these powers, the court has regard to the conduct of the parties, the needs and financial resources of the parties, and the needs of any specified minor. Under s.5, an authorisation of arrest may be attached where actual bodily harm has been caused or is likely to be caused, so that a breach can be met with immediate arrest.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    遷出／重返令：成人 s.3(1)(c)(i)、指明未成年人 s.3(1)(c)(ii)。法院考慮三樣嘢：雙方行為、雙方需要同財政資源、指明未成年人嘅需要。s.5 逮捕授權書嘅門檻係已造成 ABH 或好可能造成 ABH。
    📌 Application: Q11 — Mary and Peter (cohabitation violence)
    Facts: Mary and Peter had cohabited for 5 years. Peter isolated Mary from others and then expelled her from the home.
    Application: As a cohabiting partner, Mary falls within the DCRVO's civil remedy. The isolation and expulsion can amount to molestation; because she has been put out of the home, the remedy she needs is an entry (re-entry) order under s.3(1)(c) to return home, together with a non-molestation order under s.3(1)(a).
    🇭🇰 中文：同居 5 年、被孤立、被趕出門 —— 重點係揀啱令：被趕走嗰方要嘅係重返令返屋企，唔係遷出令。先寫同居關係符合 DCRVO 適用範圍，再寫行為點樣構成 molestation。
  • Molestation (騷擾)
    Molestation under the DCRVO is wider than physical violence. It includes assault, intercepting or following the victim, shouting obscenities, sending abusive letters, repeatedly telephoning, and pestering. The concept therefore covers a course of harassing and controlling conduct — such as the isolation in Q11 and the intimate partner violence in Q6 — and not only a single act causing injury. Where the conduct also amounts to a criminal assault or a sexual offence, the criminal law (Cap 212 / Crimes Ordinance) and the civil DCRVO remedy should be analysed in parallel.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    Molestation 唔止打人：截停／跟蹤、大叫粗言穢語、辱罵信件、不斷打電話、纏擾都計。Q6 親密伴侶暴力同 Q11 嘅孤立控制，都要由呢個闊定義入手分析；Q5 殺嬰／家暴情境就提醒：家暴題可能同時牽涉刑事罪行，要兩條線一齊寫。
  • Guardianship — Introduction under the Mental Health Ordinance (《精神健康條例》監護・引子)
    Adult Law introduces guardianship under the Mental Health Ordinance as the protective framework for adults who cannot protect themselves. A mentally incapacitated person (MIP) in this introductory sense is a mentally disordered or mentally handicapped person who is incapable of living an independent life or of guarding against serious exploitation. Guardianship is therefore a last-resort protective intervention for adults at risk, and its full definitions, the Guardianship Board and guardian powers are examined in detail in L6.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    L4 只係引子：MIP 係精神紊亂或弱智、不能獨立生活或不能防範嚴重剝削嘅人。詳細定義、監護委員會同監護人權力留返 L6 深入講；呢度答題唔好將引子定義同 L6 Part IVB 嘅法定條件撈亂。
Short Q 出題陷阱 / 高分位 — L4 Adult Law
  • 先分清兩條路：刑事（Cap 212 / Crimes Ordinance，要證明罪行元素同舉證標準）vs 民事（DCRVO Cap 189 禁制令，唔使等定罪）；好多題兩條路都要寫。
  • Assault vs Battery 要寫定義原文：assault = apprehension of immediate unlawful violence（未掂到）；battery = actual intentional unlawful use of force（已掂到）。
  • DCRVO 落 sub-section 要準：不騷擾令成人 s.3(1)(a) / 指明未成年人 s.3(1)(b)；遷出／重返令成人 s.3(1)(c)(i) / 未成年人 s.3(1)(c)(ii)；課程係 s.3(1A)；逮捕授權係 s.5，門檻係 ABH 已造成或好可能造成。
  • 刑罰唔好對調：rape s.118 = life；indecent assault s.122 = 10 years；OAPO s.39 / s.19 = 3 years；s.17 = life；s.27 = 3–10 years。
  • Ho Mai / Mei Li 係討論情境唔係判例：要寫 forced sex after refusal → s.118 分析 + 女兒披露後學校社工嘅角色，唔好虛構判決結果。
L5 兒童法 Child Law福利原則必背
  • Divorce — Irretrievable Breakdown & the Five Facts (離婚・婚姻無可挽救破裂與五個事實)
    Under the Matrimonial Causes Ordinance, Cap 179, s.11A, the sole ground for divorce is that the marriage has broken down irretrievably. Breakdown is proved by one of five facts: (1) adultery; (2) unreasonable behaviour; (3) separation for 1 year with the respondent's consent; (4) living apart for 2 years; (5) desertion for 1 year. The petitioner must plead and prove a fact — dissatisfaction with the marriage alone is not enough — and once divorce is engaged, the court's focus shifts to the children's welfare and financial provision.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    離婚唯一理由係 s.11A 婚姻破裂至無可挽救，再用五個事實證明：通姦、不合理行為、雙方同意分居 1 年、分居 2 年、遺棄 1 年。MC 陷阱係年期：同意分居係 1 年、無同意分居係 2 年、遺棄係 1 年，唔好對調。
  • UN Convention on the Rights of the Child & the Best Interests Principle (《兒童權利公約》與兒童最佳利益原則)
    The UN Convention on the Rights of the Child provides that a child shall not be separated from his or her parents against their will except where such separation is necessary for the best interests of the child, and that parents and others responsible for the child must protect the child from all forms of physical or mental violence, injury or abuse, neglect or negligent treatment, maltreatment or exploitation, including sexual abuse. In Hong Kong family proceedings this translates into the guiding principle that the child's best interest / welfare comes first: custody, care and access arrangements are decided by what serves the child, not by which parent has the stronger claim.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    公約兩大位：① 兒童唔應違背意願同父母分離，除非為其最佳利益而有必要；② 父母要保護兒童免受身體／精神暴力、傷害、虐待、忽略、苛待同剝削，包括性虐待。答題開頭先立 best interests 係指導原則，再套落管養同探視安排。
    📌 Application: Q10 — MIP Father & Post-divorce Co-parenting
    Facts: The father is a mentally incapacitated person (MIP), and the question concerns post-divorce co-parenting arrangements for the children.
    Application: The father's MIP status does not by itself decide custody or access. The court starts from the child's best interests, assesses the actual risk and support available, and considers co-parenting arrangements that protect the child while preserving the parent-child relationship where it is safe to do so.
    🇭🇰 中文：父親係 MIP 唔等於自動冇管養或探視權。要由兒童最佳利益出發，評估實際風險同支援，唔好用標籤代替分析 —— 呢點同 L6 嘅 MIP 定義互相呼應。
  • Welfare Principle & Welfare Checklist — Guardianship of Minors Ordinance, Cap 13, s.3(1) (福利原則與福利清單・《未成年人監護條例》第 3(1) 條)
    Under the Guardianship of Minors Ordinance, Cap 13, s.3(1), the child's welfare / best interests are the first and paramount consideration in custody and upbringing proceedings. The court considers the child's ascertainable wishes, assessed according to the child's age and understanding, together with information such as reports of the Director of Social Welfare. The welfare checklist directs attention to: the child's own wishes and feelings; the child's physical, emotional and educational needs; the child's relationships with each parent and with other persons; the likely effect of any change in circumstances; the child's age, maturity and background; any harm the child has suffered or is at risk of suffering, including family violence; each parent's capability of meeting the child's needs; and the range of powers available to the court. The exercise is not a comparison of which parent's rights are greater — the parents' claims are subordinate to what serves the child.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    Cap 13 s.3(1)：兒童最佳利益係首要同最重要考慮。福利清單要逐項對事實：兒童意願感受（按年齡同理解能力衡量）、身心及教育需要、與父母及他人嘅關係、環境改變嘅影響、年齡成熟度同背景、已受或可能受嘅傷害（包括家庭暴力）、父母照顧能力、法院可用權力範圍；再加社署署長報告等資料。陷阱位：唔可以寫成單純比較父親定母親邊個權利大 —— 父母權利要讓路畀兒童福利。
  • Maintenance for Children (兒童贍養費)
    On divorce, the court may order maintenance for a child by way of periodical payments or a lump sum. The obligation ordinarily lasts until the child reaches 18, but it may continue beyond 18 if the child is still in education or training. Maintenance is part of the welfare analysis, not a bargaining chip between the parents: the question is always what provision the child needs, for how long, and in what form.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    贍養可以定期付款或一筆過。一般到 18 歲為止；如果滿 18 歲後仍在接受教育或培訓，可以延長。寫答案要交代形式（periodical / lump sum）同期數去到幾時。
  • Separation and Maintenance Orders Ordinance — Grounds (《分居及贍養令條例》申請理由)
    The Separation and Maintenance Orders Ordinance allows a spouse to seek a separation and maintenance order on specified grounds: the other spouse has been convicted of an assault on the applicant of an aggravated character; desertion; persistent cruelty to the spouse or the children; failure to provide reasonable maintenance; insisting on sexual intercourse while suffering from venereal disease; compelling the spouse into prostitution; or being a habitual drunkard or drug addict. Each ground must be matched to the facts — persistent cruelty, for example, requires a course of conduct, not a single quarrel.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    七個理由要背齊：加重襲擊配偶定罪、遺棄、持續虐待配偶或兒童、冇提供合理贍養、患性病仍堅持性交、迫使配偶賣淫、慣性酗酒或吸毒。Persistent cruelty 要寫「持續」性質，一次爭吵唔夠。
  • Child Abuse — Definition, Types & Investigation (虐兒・定義、類型與調查)
    Child abuse is any act or omission that endangers or impairs a child's physical, psychological or emotional health or development. Its types include physical and psychological abuse, sexual abuse, gross neglect, and child prostitution. Suspected cases are investigated through referrals, a child assessment, and a Multi-Disciplinary Case Conference (MDCC), where professionals from different disciplines share information and decide together on the protection and welfare plan for the child.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    定義要寫齊 act or omission（作為或不作為）+ endangers or impairs 健康或發展。類型：身體／心理、性虐待、嚴重忽略、兒童賣淫。流程三步：轉介 → 兒童評估 → 多專業個案會議 MDCC，唔好漏咗社工喺 MDCC 嘅角色。
    📌 Case: HKSAR v L.S.T., HCCC 318/2024 (Q7)
    Facts: The boy, Z, was found emaciated, weighing only 9.7 kg, with 129 external injuries. He died from prolonged starvation leading to organ and muscle atrophy.
    Holding points (as stated in Q7): The facts as stated in the source engage gross neglect and physical abuse under the child-abuse definition, OAPO s.27 ill-treatment or neglect, and the PCJO s.34(2) care-or-protection framework; the case is used in the course to examine identification, assessment and multi-disciplinary handling of serious child abuse.
    🇭🇰 中文：男童 Z 得 9.7kg、129 處外傷、長期捱餓致器官同肌肉萎縮死亡。呢度只按 Q7 文件所載事實嚟寫；來源冇提供嘅判刑細節唔好自己加。答題重點係嚴重忽略點樣同時觸及虐兒定義、s.27 同 s.34(2)。
  • Sexual Offences Against Children — Crimes Ordinance (《刑事罪行條例》涉及兒童嘅性罪行)
    The Crimes Ordinance protects children and mentally incapacitated persons with heavy penalties: unlawful sexual intercourse with a girl under 13 — life imprisonment; with a girl under 16 — 5 years; unlawful sexual intercourse with a mentally incapacitated woman — 10 years; gross indecency towards a child under 16 — 10 years; causing or encouraging child prostitution — 10 years; and buggery — life imprisonment. The age bands are the key examination point: the younger the child, the heavier the maximum, and a child's apparent agreement does not make the act lawful.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    按年齡分級背：13 歲以下女童性交終身、16 歲以下 5 年、與精神上無行為能力女子性交 10 年、向 16 歲以下兒童粗獷猥褻 10 年、促使兒童賣淫 10 年、肛交終身。年齡帶同刑罰係 MC 最愛對調嘅位。
  • OAPO s.27 — Ill-treatment or Neglect of a Child (《侵害人身罪條例》第 27 條)
    OAPO Cap 212, s.27 makes it an offence to wilfully assault, ill-treat, neglect, abandon or expose a child in a manner likely to cause unnecessary suffering or injury to health. The slides give concrete examples of neglect: failing to provide adequate food, clothing or lodging for the child, or knowingly failing to take steps to secure help when the carer cannot provide them. The offence therefore covers omissions as much as positive acts — a carer who lets a child starve cannot defend by saying he never struck the child.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    s.27 五個動詞：wilfully assault, ill-treat, neglect, abandon, expose，結果係令兒童不必要受苦或健康受損。例子要識舉：冇提供足夠食物、衣物、住宿，或者明知自己提供唔到都唔去求助 —— 不作為一樣入罪，呼應 L3 omissions 嘅法律責任。
  • Child in Need of Care or Protection — PCJO Cap 213, s.34(2) (需要照顧或保護嘅兒童)
    Under the Protection of Children and Juveniles Ordinance, Cap 213, s.34(2), a child or juvenile is in need of care or protection if: (a) he has been or is being assaulted, ill-treated, neglected or sexually abused; (b) his health, development or welfare has been neglected or avoidably impaired; (c) his health, development or welfare is likely to be neglected or avoidably impaired; or (d) he is beyond control to the extent that harm may be caused to him or others. The Director of Social Welfare (DSW) may act as legal guardian, and the court may make a care order or a supervision order — supervision may last up to 3 years, with the supervisor's role to advise, assist and befriend the child and family.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    s.34(2) 四項 (a)–(d) 要逐項背：已被虐待／忽略／性虐待；健康發展福利已被忽略或可避免受損；好可能被忽略受損；不受控制到可能造成傷害。後果：社署署長可做法定監護人、法庭可發照顧令或監管令，監管最長 3 年，監管人角色係 advise, assist and befriend。
Short Q 出題陷阱 / 高分位 — L5 Child Law
  • 任何兒童題第一句先立原則：the child's best interests / welfare is the guiding principle，再先至落管養、探視或贍養分析，次序倒轉會失結構分。
  • 離婚五個事實年期唔好錯：consensual separation 1 year、living apart 2 years、desertion 1 year；唯一理由永遠係 s.11A irretrievable breakdown。
  • 分清三條保護線：刑事 OAPO s.27（懲罰施虐者）、民事保護 PCJO s.34(2)（照顧／監管令）、程序 MDCC（多專業決定）；一條題隨時要三線齊寫。
  • s.34(2) 要逐項 (a)–(d) 對事實，特別係 (c) likely to be impaired —— 未受傷害都可以介入，唔使等傷害發生。
  • 引 Q7 HKSAR v L.S.T. HCCC 318/2024 只寫來源事實：9.7 kg、129 injuries、prolonged starvation → organ/muscle atrophy；唔好加來源冇嘅判刑或情節。
L6 精神健康・遺囑認證・法律援助定義題溫床
  • Mental Disorder — MHO Cap 136, s.2 (精神紊亂・《精神健康條例》第 2 條)
    Mental Health Ordinance, Cap 136, s.2 defines mental disorder as: (a) mental illness; (b) arrested or incomplete development of mind, including a significant impairment of intelligence and social functioning associated with abnormally aggressive or seriously irresponsible conduct; (c) psychopathic disorder; or (d) any other disorder or disability of the mind which does not amount to mental handicap. The definition is a legal gateway, not a medical diagnosis: only a person who falls within s.2 can be made subject to the Ordinance's reception, detention and guardianship powers.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    精神紊亂四類：精神病、心智發展受阻或不完全（智能同社交功能顯著受損＋異常侵略或嚴重不負責任行為）、精神病理障礙、其他未達弱智程度嘅心智障礙。記住最後一句：唔屬於 mental handicap 嗰啲先落 (d)，兩個定義唔好撈亂。
  • Mental Handicap, Mental Incapacity, MIP, Patient & Relative (弱智・精神上無行為能力・MIP・病人・親屬)
    Mental handicap means sub-average general intellectual functioning with deficiencies in adaptive behaviour — an IQ of 70 or below on the Wechsler scales. Mental incapacity means mental disorder or mental handicap. A mentally incapacitated person (MIP) means, for Part II purposes, a person who is incapable by reason of mental incapacity of managing and administering his property and affairs — and otherwise means a patient or a mentally handicapped person. A patient is a person suffering or appearing to be suffering from a mental disorder. A relative must be aged 18 or above and includes a spouse, child, parent, sibling, grandparent, grandchild, uncle or aunt, nephew or niece, cousin, and a person residing with the MIP.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    定義鏈要順序背：mental handicap（IQ ≤ 70 韋氏量表＋適應行為缺損）→ mental incapacity = mental disorder or mental handicap → MIP（Part II 指不能管理財產事務；其他情況指 patient 或弱智人士）。Relative 要 18 歲以上，同住者都計，呢點同 s.59N 邊個可以申請監護直接相關。
  • Part II — Management of Property & Affairs (第 II 部・財產及事務管理)
    Part II of the MHO deals with the property and affairs of an MIP who cannot manage them himself. s.9 gives the court power to examine the position; s.10 sets out the court's powers over the MIP's property and affairs; and under s.11, where the person is incapable, the court may appoint a committee to act for him. The Part II route is about money and property — it is different from Part IVB guardianship, which is about personal and welfare decisions.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    Part II 管錢銀財產：s.9 查核權、s.10 法院權力、s.11 委任 committee（產業受託監管人）。最常見陷阱係將 Part II 同 Part IVB 監護撈亂：一個管財產、一個管個人福利決定，答題要先分清題目問邊樣。
  • Part III — Reception, Detention & Treatment (第 III 部・接收及羈留)
    Part III balances treatment against liberty. A s.30 voluntary patient is admitted on his own application and is free in principle to leave. Under s.31(1B), a person may be removed and detained for observation on the opinion of one medical officer, through an order of a District judge or magistrate. Under s.36, a certified patient may be detained for treatment, supported by two medical officers. The number of doctors and the authorising authority are the precise points examined: observation under s.31 needs one medical officer plus a judge or magistrate; detention of a certified patient under s.36 needs two.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    三級記法：s.30 自願病人（自己申請入院）、s.31(1B) 觀察羈留（1 名醫生意見＋法官／裁判官）、s.36 證明病人羈留（2 名醫生）。醫生人數係 MC 同 Short Q 嘅送分／陷阱位，千祈唔好調轉。
  • Mental Health Review Tribunal & Guardianship Board (精神健康覆核審裁處・監護委員會)
    Part IV / IVA establishes the Mental Health Review Tribunal (see s.59E), which reviews the detention of patients. Part IVB establishes the Guardianship Board: its functions are set out in s.59K, and its guiding principles are the interests of the MIP and respect for the views and wishes of the MIP. The two bodies do different work — the Tribunal reviews detention, while the Board decides guardianship for personal and welfare matters.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    覆核審裁處（Part IV/IVA，s.59E）覆核羈留；監護委員會（Part IVB，s.59K）決定監護。委員會兩大原則：MIP 嘅利益 + MIP 嘅意願 —— 寫監護題一定要兩樣都提，淨寫「為佢好」唔夠。
  • Applying for Guardianship — ss.59M, 59N, 59P & 59S; the Criteria (申請監護・程序與批出條件)
    A guardianship application under s.59M must be founded on the written reports of 2 registered medical practitioners, and guardianship must be in the interests of the welfare of the MIP or for the protection of other persons. Under s.59N, the applicants who may apply are a relative, a social worker, a registered medical practitioner, or a public officer of the Social Welfare Department. A social enquiry report is prepared under s.59P, and under s.59S a guardian must be a willing adult who is capable of providing care and has no conflict of interest. The Board will grant guardianship only where: the person has a mental disorder or mental handicap; the disorder limits his ability to make reasonable decisions about all or a substantial proportion of his personal circumstances; his needs can only be met by guardianship, with no other less restrictive means available; and it is in the interests of his welfare or for the protection of others.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    程序四條文：s.59M 申請基礎（2 名註冊醫生書面報告）、s.59N 申請人（親屬、社工、註冊醫生、社署公職人員）、s.59P 社會調查報告、s.59S 監護人資格（自願成年、有能力照顧、冇利益衝突）。批出四條件最重要係第三項：needs only met by guardianship + no less restrictive means —— 監護係最後手段。
    📌 Case: Director of Social Welfare v Mr L (2007)
    Facts: Mr L was an 82-year-old singleton suffering from senile dementia. He owned property worth millions and was at risk of financial abuse.
    Holding points: The case illustrates guardianship as a protective measure where dementia has removed the ability to guard against exploitation — the risk to his substantial property made intervention in his interests, rather than leaving him exposed to financial abuse.
    🇭🇰 中文：82 歲獨居、老年痴呆、物業價值數百萬、正被財政剝削。對應批出條件：有精神紊亂、決定能力受限、需要監護嚟保障福利。答題要將「財產龐大＋被剝削風險」連去 protection 呢一點。
    📌 Case: Ms L v Mr W (2008)
    Facts: Mr W was a 74-year-old man with senile dementia and a public housing tenant, who was at risk of being driven out of his home by a relative.
    Holding points: The case shows guardianship protecting an MIP's place of residence against a relative — the very decision (where the MIP lives) that falls within a guardian's powers, and an example of a need ground based on danger to the MIP's housing and welfare.
    🇭🇰 中文：74 歲、老年痴呆、公屋住戶、被親屬趕走嘅風險。呢單對應監護人「決定居所」嘅權力，同 Mr L 案一富一基層咁對讀：監護保護嘅唔止財產，亦包括居所同基本生活。
  • Guardian's Powers & When Guardianship Is Needed (監護人權力與需要監護嘅情況)
    A guardian's powers are limited and specific: to decide the MIP's place of residence; to consent to medical or dental treatment on the MIP's behalf; and to manage a limited amount of money — a maximum of HK$10,500 per month. Grounds showing a need for guardianship include disagreement over the MIP's care, the MIP's objection to a placement, refusal of treatment, and abuse, neglect, self-neglect, exploitation, or danger to health. Because the powers are limited, guardianship should be presented in answers as a proportionate, least-restrictive intervention — not as a general power to control the MIP's life.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    監護人三權：決定居所、同意醫療／牙科治療、管理有限金錢（上限每月 $10,500）。需要監護嘅情況：照顧安排有爭議、反對入住安排、拒絕治療、虐待／忽略／自我忽略／剝削／健康危險。$10,500 呢個數字係必背畀分點。
  • Probate, Wills & Intestacy (遺囑認證・平安紙・無遺囑繼承)
    Probate is the court process of proving the validity and authenticity of a will; the executor named in the will obtains a grant of probate to administer the estate. The key instruments are a Will (平安紙), an Enduring Power of Attorney under Cap 501, and an Advance Directive. The governing statutes include the Wills Ordinance, Cap 30 and the Probate and Administration Ordinance, Cap 10. Where there is no will, the Intestates' Estates Ordinance, Cap 73, s.4(2) applies: if the intestate leaves a spouse and no issue and no parent or sibling, the whole estate goes to the surviving spouse; and if there is no surviving relative at all, the estate passes to the HKSAR Government as bona vacantia.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    三件工具分清：平安紙（死後分配）、持久授權書 Cap 501（在生時授權處理事務）、預設醫療指示（醫療意願）。Probate 定義要寫齊 proving validity/authenticity + executor obtains grant。無遺囑 s.4(2) 兩個極端位：只有配偶 → 配偶全取；完全冇親屬 → 歸政府 bona vacantia。
    📌 Case: Chan Chun Chuen, HCCC 182/2012
    Facts: Chan Chun Chuen was prosecuted for forgery of a will purporting to be the will of the late Mrs Nina Wang.
    Holding points: Forging a will is a serious criminal offence: forgery carries a maximum of 14 years' imprisonment under the Crimes Ordinance. The case shows why probate requires the court to prove a will's authenticity before any grant is made.
    🇭🇰 中文：陳振聰偽造聲稱係龔如心遺囑 —— 偽造文件最高 14 年（Crimes Ordinance）。答題價值在於帶出 probate 點解要認證真偽：遺囑一假，成個遺產分配都假。
  • Legal Aid — Means Test & Merits Test (法律援助・經濟審查與案情審查)
    Legal aid is administered by the Legal Aid Department and requires the applicant to pass two tests. The means test assesses financial eligibility: monthly disposable income multiplied by 12, plus disposable capital; an owner-occupied property is excluded, and for applicants over 60 a disregard equal to the Ordinary Legal Aid Scheme financial eligibility limit applies to capital. The merits test requires a reasonable chance of success — the Director of Legal Aid must be satisfied that the case has merits before aid is granted. Both tests must be passed; a strong case alone is not enough if the applicant is over the means limit, and vice versa.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    兩關都要過：means test（每月可動用收入 ×12 ＋ 可動用資本；自住物業唔計；60 歲以上有等同普通法援上限嘅資本豁免）＋ merits test（有合理勝算、署長信納有案情理據）。寫答案要逐關分析個案，唔好淨寫「窮就得」。
Short Q 出題陷阱 / 高分位 — L6 Mental Health & Probate
  • 定義題要引 s.2 原文元素：mental handicap 必須寫 IQ 70 or below on Wechsler scales + deficiencies in adaptive behaviour，淨寫「智力低」冇分。
  • 分清三組易混位：Part II（財產・committee）vs Part IVB（福利・guardian）；s.31(1B) 1 名醫生 vs s.36 2 名醫生；覆核審裁處（羈留）vs 監護委員會（監護）。
  • 監護批出條件要寫齊四項，特別係 no less restrictive means —— 冇寫最後手段原則，成段分析唔完整；再加 s.59K 兩原則：interests of the MIP + views and wishes of the MIP。
  • 數字位：guardian 管理金錢上限 HK$10,500/month；偽造文件最高 14 years；法援 means test 公式係 monthly disposable income × 12 + disposable capital。
  • Probate 要落定義：court process proving validity/authenticity + executor obtains grant of probate；無遺囑要引 Cap 73 s.4(2)，唔好自己作分配比例 —— 來源冇寫嘅情況唔好推演。
L7 侵權法 Tort — 疏忽係重心四元素必考
  • What is a Tort? (侵權法是甚麼)
    A tort is a civil wrong: a breach of a legal duty which affects an individual's interests, and it belongs to private law. It differs from public law, from criminal law — which punishes offenders and protects the public interest — and from contract law, where the obligations arise from voluntary agreement between the parties.
    Its functions are to protect rights and to compensate loss. The interests protected are: personal interests (bodily integrity, and reputation, protected through defamation), property interests (the integrity of property, the enjoyment of land, protected through nuisance, and intangible interests such as passing off and intellectual property), and economic interests (pure economic loss, and deceit). Relief is usually damages, but an injunction may also be granted.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    侵權係違反法律責任、影響個人利益嘅民事過錯，屬私法。唔好同刑事法撈亂：刑事法處罰罪犯、保障公眾利益；侵權法保障個人權利同補償損失。救濟以損害賠償為主，亦可申請禁制令。
  • Negligence: The Four Elements (疏忽四元素)
    To succeed in negligence, the claimant must prove four elements in order: (1) Duty of Care — the defendant owed the claimant a duty to take care; (2) Breach of Duty — the defendant fell below the standard of the reasonable person; (3) Causation — the breach caused the damage; and (4) Damage — the claimant suffered loss of a kind the law will compensate. If any one element fails, the whole claim fails.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
    四元素要順序逐個證明，缺一不可。Short Q 分析任何疏忽情境，都要逐個元素套事實，唔好跳過 Duty 直接講賠償；Q16 BGCA 案正正係用呢四元素逐項拆解。
  • Duty of Care (謹慎責任)
    A duty of care exists within certain established classes of relationship, such as employer–employee, doctor–patient and school–pupils. Outside those classes, the court asks whether the claimant belonged to a class of persons who would foreseeably suffer loss from the defendant's conduct, and whether the kind of damage suffered was foreseeable.
    🇭🇰 中文導讀：
